summary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The v6 successor preserves the six-obligation measurement and sole leftoverDesign item OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING, keeps G20 and DR-125 open, keeps required-now 28, preserves occupancy v2 and sdk-leftover-join.v6 as the current recorded measurements, and creates no qualification or implementation authority. It also correctly records g20-leftover-join.v5 as an unmoved CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED Dual REJECT and lands all three required v5 finding identifiers. The shared MUST-FIX-1 / CODEX-G20LJ-V5-SF1 class is repaired in basedOn.sdkJoinV4.role, and SHOULD-FIX-1 is repaired in basedOn.predecessorV4.role with explicit sdk family qualifiers.
discipline: Attempted to falsify custody, syntax, recorded-input closure, lineage currency, finding disposition, obligation arithmetic, live register state, and authority boundaries. Acceptance follows only because every dispatch and independent attack was refuted on pinned bytes.
